subject: sub-001
scope: individual patient only; no population model, no cross-patient training, no population EZ frequency
observation_pipeline: artifact clipping, 10 Hz high-pass, 100-sample log power, 1 Hz low-pass, model-time resampling

optimization.selection: maximum Stan lp__ using observation likelihood and priors only

primary_ezn_score: MAP x0; larger is more epileptogenic
secondary_propagation_output: MAP generated-quantity source x: first x>0 onset and Nature Computational Science 2025 EV
truth_policy: EZ and PZ are forbidden during feature extraction, optimization, start selection, and prediction export; they are loaded only after prediction SHA256 is frozen.
claim_boundary: Synthetic VEP single-patient demonstration; not posterior uncertainty, cohort generalization, clinical validation, or deployment evidence.
